title: Project/shared Nx project.json
description: Required test targets for project/shared project.json. Checks use the test:* namespace; build is separate. Use test:eslint (never test:lint). test:alint is required. Playwright lane targets test:functional / test:seo / test:analytics / test:cwv are optional in schema (declare when the project has webapp/docapp/extapp narrow-integration harness; inventory requires test:cwv script when webapp/docapp or flat-root PW exists). test:pulumi is always required (index-clusters + mocks; never noop). Orchestration targets such as git:status are optional (not a governance gate). Shipped by @sargonpiraev/eslint-config.

test:pulumi.description: Always required. index-clusters + Pulumi mocks; never noop.
